== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 30: the slip of [[Order 66 (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand The Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
